messages:
jin: FYI — noticed a small but steady uptick in page-migration events on GPU cards in pool-17 (cards c4 and c7). Seen since 03:10 UTC, about +18 remap ops in last 2h. Not urgent yet but trend looks like early page retirement. I'll pull recent ECC/Xid and remap counters.
sam: nice catch. can you paste the query you ran? thinking if we should soft-drain c4.
jin: query:
```promql
increase(nvidia_gpu_memory_page_remap_total{pool="pool-17"}[2h])
```
results: c4=18, c7=14, others <=2
priya: if c4 hits >30 in 6h let's drain. also add tag 'watch:page-migration' on those nodes.
mateo: running nvml diagnostic on c4 now.
ops-bot: soft-drain initiated: `fleetctl drain gpu-p17-c4 --mode=soft --reason='page-migration'` — will stop new allocations, finish running jobs. (initiated by sam)
jin: nvml diag summary: ECC corrected spikes correlating with remap windows, no Xid yet. Memory errors increasing but corrected. attaching snippet:
```text
GPU c4: ECC_CORRECTED=120->138 (+18)
GPU c7: ECC_CORRECTED=95->109 (+14)
Xid: 0
```
sam: good. I'll keep c7 on watch. priya — can you open replacement ticket and tag vendor under priority-low? Add drain plan if c4 crosses 30.
priya: opened ticket INF-4721, scheduled spare from pool-19 to aws-usw2; tagging nodes with `wobbly-memory`.
mateo: capacity note — moving one spare will reduce burst headroom by ~6% in usw2 during peak. we have runway but monitor.
jin: I'll set an alert on the remap rate: alert if increase(nvidia_gpu_memory_page_remap_total[6h]) > 25 for any card.
sam: perfect. add a dashboard widget under /infra/gpu/pool-17 -> 'page migration (per card)'.
ops-bot: alert rule created: gpu_page_migration_rate_high (threshold=25/6h) by jin
priya: thanks. will coordinate replacement once drain finishes. :thumbsup:
